key_features: Three Exciting Light Modes to Ignite Jumping Fun: This LED light up jump rope for kids features built-in lights with three dynamic modes: strobe flash, breathing fade, and steady glow. A simple button press lets you switch modes easily. At night, the vibrant light show makes skipping more thrilling, encouraging kids to play outdoors and enjoy daily exercise

Non-Slip Rubber Handles for a Comfortable Grip: These glow in the dark beaded jump rope handles are made of high-quality non-slip rubber with an ergonomic curved design and textured surface. They provide a secure, sweat-resistant grip that reduces wrist fatigue and helps children maintain a smooth jumping rhythm with ease

TPE Segmented Bamboo-Style Rope – Tangle-Free & Smooth Rotation: The rope is constructed with soft TPE segments (bamboo-joint style) over a clear PVC tube that encases the LED wire. This segmented design keeps the beaded jump rope flexible yet durable, preventing twisting and tangling while ensuring stable, smooth rotation. When it taps the ground, it produces a satisfying rhythmic "click click" sound to help young jumpers keep their timing

Adjustable Length Grows with Your Child: The total length of the light up jump rope for kids is 9.2 feet, and can be easily adjusted (by cutting or tying knots as needed) to fit different heights. Suitable for children, teens, and even adults, this single jump rope can accompany your child from kindergarten through upper elementary years – no need to buy a new one as they grow

A Fun, Active Gift That Inspires Healthy Habits: This light-up segmented jump rope for kids makes an excellent gift for birthdays, Children's Day, Halloween, Christmas, or back-to-school. The cool lighting effects combined with jumping fun help pull kids away from screens while improving coordination and fitness – a meaningful and exciting present kids will truly love
